title: XOR.DDoS_Botnet_Investigation_d90
description: Investigate and mitigate the threat posed by the XOR.DDoS botnet malware.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The network has been experiencing unusual traffic patterns and potential command-and-control (C2) communications. Your task is to investigate and mitigate the threat posed by the XOR.DDoS botnet malware.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: Access the sandbox via the provided cloud environment. Username: trainee, Password: trainee123. Enter 'start' to begin.
levels.local_content: Instructions for local sandbox usage. Username: trainee, Password: trainee123. Enter 'start' to begin.

levels.title: Identify Suspicious Service
levels.content: Identify and investigate an unauthorized or suspicious service responsible for periodic external communication. Enumerate running services and identify beaconing behavior associated with botnet activity.
levels.solution: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently added services. The service name must be identified and reported.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the systemd services and look for any unusual or recently added services.

levels.title: Determine C2 Server
levels.content: Determine the external host communicating with the compromised system. Investigate network connections and identify the command-and-control server.
levels.solution: Examine the network connections and logs for any suspicious outbound connections. The C2 IP address must be identified and reported.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine the network connections and logs for any suspicious outbound connections.

levels.title: Identify Flooding Target
levels.content: Identify the system receiving the abnormal volume of network traffic generated by the compromised host. Analyze network flows to determine the victim of the flooding activity.
levels.solution: Review the network traffic logs and look for any unusual destination IPs. The victim IP address must be identified and reported.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Review the network traffic logs and look for any unusual destination IPs.
